title: Compute Engine: VMs, Disks, and Managed Instance Groups — D4
purpose: Shows identities, trust boundaries, policy checks, and audit evidence.
routing_rationale: Compute Engine isolates virtual machines across availability zones. Regional MIGs balance VM counts across zones, while Regional Persistent Disks synchronously replicate data.

nodes.label: Global External ALB
nodes.detail: Distributes HTTP traffic across healthy backend VM instances in all zones.

nodes.label: Regional Health Check
nodes.detail: Probes port 8080 /healthz; informs MIG manager of dead instances.

nodes.label: Regional Instance Group Mgr
nodes.detail: Maintains target capacity; automatically recreates failed instances from template.

nodes.label: VM Instance (Zone A)
nodes.detail: Primary serving instance processing application workloads.

nodes.label: Regional Persistent Disk
nodes.detail: Synchronously replicates block storage writes across Zone A and Zone B.

steps.title: Load Balancer Dispatch
steps.action: Load balancer forwards user transaction to healthy VM instance in Zone A.
steps.why_traversal: Anycast distributes traffic to optimal zonal endpoints.

steps.title: Synchronous Disk Write
steps.action: VM commits data block; Regional PD replicates to Zone B before acknowledging write.
steps.why_traversal: Regional PD achieves RPO=0 across zonal datacenter outages.

steps.title: Continuous Health Probing
steps.action: Health prober validates response; reports healthy status to MIG controller.
steps.why_traversal: Enables proactive eviction if backend becomes unresponsive.

scenarios.label: Zonal Datacenter Hardware Failure
scenarios.root_cause: Hypervisor host hardware crash terminates VM in Zone A.
scenarios.diverted_path: Health check flags timeout; MIG auto-heals by provisioning replacement VM in Zone B.
scenarios.blast_radius: In-flight request retried by ALB; Regional PD reattaches with zero data loss.
scenarios.recovery: Instance template boots in Zone B and mounts existing Regional PD.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Shows identities, trust boundaries, policy checks, and audit evidence.
